//: AIR crafting impact tiers (09.10.2026): the colour a recipe's name wears in the crafting panel, so the things worth looking at stand out when a skill level is reached. Original Prologue design, computed by src/game/crafting/RecipeImpact.js from the catalogue; `rules` are its thresholds and `tiers` are overrides that win over the rule (ids of recipe results).

rules.//: cookedCaloriesAtLeast: a cooked food with at least this many calories is epic (cooked vegetables count). intermediateUses: a result that is a component of at least this many recipes is an ingredient and sits no higher than uncommon unless the rule or an override says otherwise; food and wound care are spared up to ingredientManyUses, past which they too are ingredients first (a cotton sheet). bigContainerLitres: the first container of at least this room at a level is rare. waterIds: drinkable water results, legendary.
